name: cryptoworldz-bot
description: Official CryptoWorldz Telegram Bot with Diamond Buy Auto SAFE LOCKED service

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check db.js && find src test public -type f -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} +
scripts.check:auto: node --check auto-server.js && find src/auto -type f -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} +
scripts.check:structure: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const forbidden=['apps/cryptoworldz-web-core','apps/oneworldz-hub-central','apps/worldz-sites','master-use-library','media','diagnostics','docs','.github/certifications'];for(const p of forbidden)if(fs.existsSync(p))throw new Error('Retired path returned: '+p);if(!fs.existsSync('apps/oneworldz-ecosystem-release'))throw new Error('Canonical static build root missing');const gateway=fs.readFileSync('src/pdc-host.js','utf8');if(/WORLDZ_HOSTS|express\.static|cryptoworldz-web-core/.test(gateway))throw new Error('Retired public-domain fallback gateway returned');const actual=fs.readdirSync('.github/workflows').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.yml')||x.endsWith('.yaml')).sort();const allowed=['command-centre-v4.yml','main.yml','resolve-community-facebook-profiles.yml'].sort();if(JSON.stringify(actual)!==JSON.stringify(allowed))throw new Error('Workflow allowlist drift: '+actual.join(','));const gate=fs.readFileSync('governance/JAYJAY-CHATGPT-DEPLOYMENT-GATE.md','utf8');for(const token of ['Single-Rail Total Deployment Gate','HOSTINGER DESTINATION PASS','No GitHub Actions static deployment workflow is required','No-repeat approval rule for the current total deployment'])if(!gate.includes(token))throw new Error('Deployment gate drift: '+token);const state=fs.readFileSync('deployments/oneworldz-19-total.request','utf8');for(const token of ['state=TOTAL_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_ACTIVE','owner_authority=PERFORM_TOTAL_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN','canonical_deployment_rail=ONE_AUTHENTICATED_HOSTINGER_STATIC_FLEET_RAIL'])if(!state.includes(token))throw new Error('Deployment state drift: '+token);const targets=fs.readFileSync('apps/oneworldz-ecosystem-release/production-targets.mjs','utf8');for(const token of ['TOTAL_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_ACTIVE','ONE_AUTHENTICATED_HOSTINGER_STATIC_FLEET_RAIL','HOSTINGER_PROOF_REQUIRED'])if(!targets.includes(token))throw new Error('Target contract drift: '+token);"
scripts.verify:web: npm run check:structure && npm run build:ecosystem-release && npm run check:web
scripts.verify: npm run check:structure && npm run check && npm run build:ecosystem-release && npm test && npm run check:web && npm run check:auto
